critical_code_review_comments: CookieBanner correctly gates on localStorage 'tl_cookie_consent'; save() persists consent object for accept/reject/save.
Login anchors use target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer' — good.
Modal has data-testid modal-overlay/modal-close and closes on backdrop click and X — good.
Language is React context (in-memory); by design resets on reload — cookie banner text updates reactively when switching lang within same session (verified).
